basic_info.description: SoHo-inspired, stunning 2-bed, 2-bath, 1,970+ sqft  warehouse conversion at 735 Clementina Street with an epic skylight and dramatic sense of space. Nestled in the heart of San Francisco, this legal one-family home feels miles away from the usual city grind you think of when it comes to SoMa, echoing the loft-style living of New York's trendiest neighborhoods instead. Tall 12.5-foot ceilings, radiant-heated polished concrete floors and the dramatic 35-foot skylight with power shades flood the space with natural light. A bold red front door with ample closet space leads to an open living area that artfully combines industrial elements with modern design think exposed brick, reclaimed wood beams. Upstairs, oversized windows overlook the peaceful, tree-lined lane once known as Photographers Row. The gourmet kitchen, complete with stainless steel appliances, an oversized movable island and pantry, is ideal for entertaining. A private rooftop deck offers a serene retreat. A huge closet anchors a luxe primary bedroom with steam shower. The large garage includes ample storage and a workbench behind a commercial roll-up door with room for a car stacker. 735 offers a unique and sophisticated urban escape complete with a well-run benefits district that does wonders for the neighborhood.
